policy: committed tables are the analysis slice plus schema and a sample; full tables and every parquet stay under the local output tree, which is not committed
privacy: no committed table carries a latitude or longitude; positions are relative metres and track endpoints are trimmed

tables.full_scope: every configured bin size, both domains

tables.committed_scope: first 50 events, identifying columns and deltas only
tables.full_scope: every event, every window, every signal family
